g.text: Maintainer / authorized workflow
Declared public distribution
Select reviewed intent, version, profile and exact start authority
Prepare owned projections and cheap preflight; no public effects
Build isolated candidate from exact prepared basis
Verify canonical inventory, resources and actual artifact metadata
Exercise actual packed CLI and trusted archives in clean fixtures
Actual scoped outcomes and preservation observations
Retained candidate identity and actual qualification observations
Check all applicable duties and exact authority before each write
Publish retained bytes in authorized boundary order
Authoritative observations; unknown and partial remain explicit
Fresh public acquisition and installation smoke
Actual public identities and effects
Durable version-bound closeout or explicit failure/recovery scope
Obtain supported identified CLI through declared trust path
Selected package and trusted distribution integrity
Explicit target, source, destination and replacement scope
Verify candidate; preflight all units; recheck and change bounded scope
Actual installed units or attributable partial/blocked outcome
